heading.en: King Lamoni supposes that Ammon is the Great Spirit—Ammon teaches the king about the Creation, God's dealings with men, and the redemption that comes through Christ—Lamoni believes and falls to the earth as if dead. About 90 B.C.
heading.sm: Ua manatu le Tupu o Lamonae o Amona o le Agaga Silisili lea—Ua a'oa'o atu e Amona le tupu e uiga i le Foafoaga, o feutaga'iga a le Atua ma tagata, ma le togiola e oo mai e ala mai ia Keriso—Ua talitonu Lamonae ma ua pa'ū ifo i le eleele e pei ua oti. E tusa o le 90 T.L.M.

verses.en: And it came to pass that king Lamoni caused that his servants should stand forth and testify to  all the things which they had seen concerning the matter.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina faatonu atu le tupu o Lamonae ia tutula’i mai ana auauna ma molimau mai i mea uma ia sa latou vaai i ai e uiga i le mataupu.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And when they had all testified to the things which they had seen, and he had learned of the faithfulness of Ammon in preserving his flocks, and also of his great power in contending against those who sought to slay him, he was astonished exceedingly, and said: Surely, this is more than a man. Behold, is not this the Great Spirit who doth send such great punishments upon this people, because of their murders?
verses.sm: Ma ina ua uma ona latou molimau atu i mea na latou vaai i ai, ma ua iloa ai e ia le faamaoni o Amona i le faasaoina o ana lafu manu, ma e uiga foi i lona mana tele i le tauiviga faasaga ia te i latou o ē na saili e fasioti ia te ia, sa ofo tele o ia, ma fai mai: E moni lava, ua sili atu lenei nai lo o se tagata. Faauta, pe le o le Agaga Silisili ea lenei o lē ua ia auina mai faasalaga matautia faapea i luga o lenei nuu, ona o lo latou fasioti tagata?

verses.en: And they answered the king, and said: Whether he be the Great Spirit or a man, we know not; but this much we do know, that he cannot be slain by the enemies of the king; neither can they scatter the king's flocks when he is with us, because of his expertness and great strength; therefore, we know that he is a friend to the king. And now, O king, we do not believe that a man has such great power, for we know he cannot be slain.
verses.sm: Ma sa latou tali atu i le tupu, ma fai atu: Pe o ia o le Agaga Silisili po o se tagata, matou te le iloa; ae ona pau lenei o le mea ua matou iloa, e le mafai ona fasiotia o ia e fili o le tupu; pe mafai foi ona latou faasalalauina o lafu manu a le tupu pe a faatasi o ia ma i matou, ona o lona atamai ma lona malosi tele; o lea, ua matou iloa ai o ia o se uo a le tupu. Ma o lenei, le tupu e, matou te lē talitonu ua i ai i se tagata se mana tele faapea, ona ua matou iloa e le mafai ona fasiotia o ia.

w.en: by the enemies of the king;

verses.en: And now, when the king heard these words, he said unto them: Now I know that it is the Great Spirit; and he has come down at this time to preserve your lives, that I might not slay you as I did your brethren. Now this is the Great Spirit of whom our fathers have spoken.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, ina ua uma ona faalogo mai o le tupu i nei upu, sa ia fai mai ia te i latou: Ua ou iloa nei o ia o le Agaga Silisili; ma ua afio mai o ia i le taimi nei e faasao o outou ola, ina ia le mafai ona ou fasioti ia te outou e pei ona sa ou faia i o outou uso. O lenei o le Agaga Silisili lenei o lē na tautalatala i ai o tatou tamā.

verses.en: Now this was the tradition of Lamoni, which he had received from his father, that there was a Great Spirit. Notwithstanding they believed in a Great Spirit they supposed that whatso– ever they did was right; nevertheless, Lamoni began to fear exceedingly, with fear lest he had done wrong in slaying his servants;
verses.sm: O lea o le uputuu lenei a Lamonae, lea na ia maua mai i lona tamā, e faapea ua i ai se Agaga Silisili. Peitai e ui ina sa latou talitonu i se Agaga Silisili, sa latou manatu o soo se mea sa latou faia ua sa’o; ae ui i lea, sa amata ona mata’u tele Lamonae, i le fefe ne’i meaane ua ia faia le mea sesē i le fasiotia o ana auauna;

verses.en: For he had slain many of them because their brethren had scattered their flocks at the place of water; and thus, because they had had their flocks scattered they were slain.
verses.sm: Auā sa ia fasiotia le toatele o i latou ona sa faasalalauina e o latou uso a latou lafu manu i le nofoaga o le vai; ma o lea, na fasiotia ai i latou ona sa latou tuu a latou lafu manu ia faasalalauina.

verses.en: Now it was the practice of these Lamanites to stand by the waters of Sebus to scatter the flocks of the people, that thereby they might drive away many that were scattered unto their own land, it being a practice of plunder among them.
verses.sm: O lenei sa avea ma masani a nei sa Lamanā le tutū i tafatafa o vai o Sevusa e faasalalau lafu manu a tagata, ina ia mafai ona latou tutuli ese atu ai i o latou lava laueleele le tele o manu e faasalalauina, ona o se masani lea o le faia o le vete i totonu o i latou.

verses.en: And it came to pass that king Lamoni inquired of his servants, saying: Where is this man that has such great power?
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina fesili mai le tupu o Lamonae i ana auauna, e faapea: O fea o i ai lenei tagata ua i ai lena mana tele faapea?

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And they said unto him: Behold, he is feeding thy horses. Now the king had commanded his servants, previous to the time of the watering of their flocks, that they should prepare his horses and chariots, and conduct him forth to the land of Nephi; for there had been a great feast appointed at the land of Nephi, by the father of Lamoni, who was king over all the land.
verses.sm: Ma sa latou fai atu ia te ia: Faauta, o loo fafaga e ia au solofanua. O lenei sa poloaiina e le tupu ana auauna, a’o le’i oo i le taimi e faainu ai a latou lafu manu, ia latou saunia ana solofanua ma kariota, ma momoli atu o ia i le laueleele o Nifae; ona sa i ai se taumafataga tele sa atofa e faia i le laueleele o Nifae, e le tamā o Lamonae, o lē sa tupu i le laueleele uma.

verses.en: Now when king Lamoni heard that Ammon was preparing his horses and his chariots he was more astonished, because of the faithfulness of Ammon, saying: Surely there has not been any servant among all my servants that has been so  faithful as this man; for even he doth remember all my commandments to execute them.
verses.sm: O lenei ina ua faalogo mai le tupu o Lamonae o loo sauni e Amona ana solofanua ma ana kariota sa atili ofo o ia, ona o le faamaoni o Amona, ua faapea mai: E moni e le’i i ai lava se auauna i totonu o a’u auauna uma sa faamaoni e pei o lenei tagata; ona e oo lava i a’u poloaiga uma ua ia manatua ia faia i latou.

verses.en: Now I surely know that this is the Great Spirit, and I would desire him that he come in unto me, but I durst not.
verses.sm: O lenei ua ou iloa moni lava o le Agaga Silisili lenei; ma ou te manao ia te ia ia sau i totonu ia te a’u, ae ou te fefe.

w.en: that this is the Great Spirit;

verses.en: And it came to pass that when Ammon had made ready the horses and the chariots for the king and his servants, he went in unto the king, and he saw that the countenance of the king was changed; therefore he was about to return out of his presence.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina ua uma ona saunia e Amona o solofanua ma kariota mo le tupu ma ana auauna, sa alu atu o ia i totonu i le tupu, ma sa vaai atu o ia ua sui foliga o le tupu; o lea na ia sauni ai e toe foi ese mai ona luma.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And one of the king's servants said unto him, Rabbanah, which is, being interpreted, power– ful or great king, considering their kings to be powerful; and thus he said unto him: Rabbanah, the king desireth thee to stay.
verses.sm: Ma sa fai atu se tasi o auauna a le tupu ia te ia, Rapana e, o lona uiga, pe a faaliliuina, o le tupu mamana po o le tupu silisili, i lo latou manatu i o latou tupu ua mamana lava i latou; ma sa faapea ona ia fai atu ia te ia: Rapana e, ua finagalo le tupu ia e nofo mai.

verses.en: Therefore Ammon turned himself unto the king, and said unto him: What wilt thou that I should do for thee, O king? And the king answered him not for the space of an hour, according to their time, for he knew not what he should say unto him.
verses.sm: O lea na liliu atu ai e Amona o ia lava i le tupu, ma fai atu ia te ia: Le tupu e, o se a se mea ua e finagalo i ai ou te faia mo oe? Ma sa le tali mai le tupu ia te ia mo le va o se itula, e tusa ma la latou taimi, ona sa le iloa e ia se mea e tatau ona ia fai mai ia te ia.

verses.en: And it came to pass that Ammon said unto him again: What desirest thou of me? But the king answered him not.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina toe fai atu Amona ia te ia: O le a se mea ua e finagalo i ai mai ia te a’u? Peitai sa le tali mai lava le tupu ia te ia.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And it came to pass that Ammon, being filled with the Spirit of God, therefore he perceived the thoughts of the king. And he said unto him: Is it because thou hast heard that I defended thy servants and thy flocks, and slew seven of their brethren with the sling and with the sword, and smote off the arms of others, in order to defend thy flocks and thy servants; behold, is it this that causeth thy marvelings?
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina ua faatumuina Amona i le Agaga o le Atua, o lea na ia iloa ai mafaufauga o le tupu. Ma sa ia fai atu ia te ia: Pe ona ua e faafofoga ea sa ou puipuia au auauna ma au lafu manu, ma fasioti le toafitu o o latou uso i le maatā ma le pelu, ma vavae ese lima o isi, ina ia puipuia ai au lafu manu ma au auauna; faauta, o le pogai ea lenei ua e ofo ai?

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: I say unto you, what is it, that thy marvelings are so great? Behold, I am a man, and am thy servant; therefore, whatsoever thou desirest which is right, that will I do.
verses.sm: Ou te fai atu ia te oe, o le a ea le mea, ua e ofo tele ai faapea? Faauta, o a’u o se tagata, ma o a’u o lau auauna; o lea, soo se mea e te finagalo i ai ua sa’o, o le mea lena ou te faia.

verses.en: Now when the king had heard these words, he marveled again, for he beheld that Ammon could discern his thoughts; but notwithstanding this, king Lamoni did open his mouth, and said unto him: Who art thou? Art thou that Great Spirit, who knows all things?
verses.sm: O lenei ina ua faalogo mai le tupu i nei upu, sa toe ofo o ia, ona ua iloa e ia ua mafai e Amona ona iloa ona mafaufauga; ae e ui i lea, sa tatala e le tupu o Lamonae lona fofoga, ma fai mai ia te ia: O ai ea oe? O oe ea o lena Agaga Silisili, o lē ua silafia mea uma?

verses.en: Ammon answered and said unto him: I am not.
verses.sm: Sa tali atu Amona ma fai atu ia te ia: E lē o a’u lea.

verses.en: And the king said: How knowest thou the thoughts of my heart? Thou mayest speak boldly, and tell me concerning these things; and also tell me by what power ye slew and smote off the arms of my brethren that scattered my flocks—
verses.sm: Ma sa fai mai le tupu: E faapefea ona e iloa mafaufauga o lo’u loto? E mafai ona e tautala mai ma le lotoa, ma faamatala mai ia te a’u e uiga i nei mea; ma faamatala mai foi ia te a’u po o le a le mana na e fasiotia ma vavae ese ai lima o o’u uso, o ē na faataapeapeina a’u lafu manu—

verses.en: And now, if thou wilt tell me concerning these things, whatsoever thou desirest I will give unto thee; and if it were needed, I would guard thee with my armies; but I know that thou art more powerful than all they; nevertheless, whatsoever thou desirest of me I will grant it unto thee.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, afai e te faamatala mai nei mea ia te a’u, soo se mea e te manao i ai ou te avatu ia te oe; ma afai e manaomia ai, ou te leoleoina oe i a’u autau; peitai ua ou iloa ua sili atu lou mamana nai lo i latou uma; ae ui i lea, soo se mea e te manao i ai mai ia te a’u, ou te tuu atu ia te oe.

verses.en: Now Ammon being wise, yet harmless, he said unto Lamoni: Wilt thou hearken unto my words, if I tell thee by what power I do these things? And this is the thing that I desire of thee.
verses.sm: O lenei ona sa poto Amona, ae sa le gaoiā, sa ia fai atu ai ia Lamonae: E te faafofoga mai i a’u upu, pe afai ou te faamatala atu ia te oe po o le a le mana na ou faia ai nei mea? Ma o le mea lenei ou te manao i ai mai ia te oe.

verses.en: And the king answered him, and said: Yea, I will believe all thy words. And thus he was caught with guile.
verses.sm: Ma sa tali mai le tupu ia te ia, ma fai mai: Ioe, o le a ou talitonu i au upu uma. Ma sa faapea ona maua o ia i le faa’ole’ole.

verses.en: And Ammon began to speak unto him with boldness, and said unto him: Believest thou that there is a God?
verses.sm: Ma sa amata ona tautala atu o Amona ia te ia ma le lototele, ma fai atu ia te ia: E te talitonu ea e i ai se Atua?

verses.en: And he answered, and said unto him: I do not know what that meaneth.
verses.sm: Ma sa tali mai o ia, ma fai mai ia te ia: Ou te lē iloa le uiga o lena mea.

verses.en: And then Ammon said: Believest thou that there is a Great Spirit?
verses.sm: Ma ona fai atu lea o Amona: E te talitonu ea o loo i ai se Agaga Silisili?

verses.en: And he said, Yea.
verses.sm: Ma sa fai mai o ia, Ioe.

verses.en: And Ammon said: This is God. And Ammon said unto him again: Believest thou that this Great Spirit, who is God, created all things which are in heaven and in the earth?
verses.sm: Ma sa fai atu Amona: O le Atua lenei. Ma sa toe fai atu Amona ia te ia: E te talitonu ea o lenei Agaga Silisili, o le Atua lea, na foafoaina mea uma ua i le lagi ma i le lalolagi?

verses.en: And he said: Yea, I believe that he created all things which are in the earth; but I do not know the heavens.
verses.sm: Ma sa tali mai o ia: Ioe, ou te talitonu o ia na foafoaina mea uma ua i le lalolagi; ae ou te lē iloa le lagi.

verses.en: And Ammon said unto him: The heavens is a place where God dwells and all his holy angels.
verses.sm: Ma sa fai atu Amona ia te ia: O le lagi o se nofoaga lea ua afio ai le Atua ma ana agelu paia uma.

verses.en: And king Lamoni said: Is it above the earth?
verses.sm: Ma sa fai mai le tupu o Lamonae: Pe ua i luga a’e ea o le lalolagi?

verses.en: And Ammon said: Yea, and he looketh down upon all the children of men; and he knows all the thoughts and intents of the heart; for by his hand were they all created from the beginning.
verses.sm: Ma sa fai atu Amona: Ioe, ma ua silasila mai o ia i lalo i le fanauga uma a tagata; ma ua silafia e ia mafaufauga ma faamoemoega uma o le loto; auā o lona aao na foafoaina ai i latou uma lava mai i le amataga.

verses.en: And king Lamoni said: I believe all these things which thou hast spoken. Art thou sent from God?
verses.sm: Ma sa fai mai le tupu o Lamonae: Ou te talitonu i nei mea uma ua e tautala mai ai. Pe na auina mai ea oe mai le Atua?

verses.en: Ammon said unto him: I am a man; and man in the beginning was created after the image of God, and I am called by his Holy Spirit to teach these things unto this people, that they may be brought to a knowledge of that which is just and true;
verses.sm: Sa fai atu Amona ia te ia: O a’u o se tagata; ma o le tagata i le amataga sa foafoaina e tusa ma foliga o le Atua, ma ua valaauina a’u e lona Agaga Paia ou te a’oa’o atu nei mea i lenei nuu, ina ia mafai ona aumai i latou i le malamalama o mea ua tonu ma moni;

verses.en: And a portion of that Spirit dwelleth in me, which giveth me knowledge, and also power according to my faith and desires which are in God.
verses.sm: Ma ua nofo i totonu ia te au se vaega o lena Agaga, lea ua ia tuuina mai ia te au le malamalama, ma le mana foi e tusa ma lo’u faatuatua ma manaoga ia ua i ai i le Atua.

verses.en: Now when Ammon had said these words, he began at the creation of the world, and also the creation of Adam, and told him all the things concerning the fall of man, and rehearsed and laid before him the records and the holy scriptures of the people, which had been spoken by the prophets, even down to the time that their father, Lehi, left Jerusalem.
verses.sm: O lenei ina ua uma ona fai atu e Amona nei upu, sa ia amata mai i le foafoaga o le lalolagi, ma le foafoaga foi o Atamu, ma faamatala atu ia te ia mea uma e uiga i le pa’ū o le tagata, ma faamatala ma fola atu i ona luma talafaamaumau ma tusitusiga paia a le nuu, ia na fetalai i ai perofeta, seia oo mai i lalo i le taimi na tuua ai e lo latou tamā o Liae, Ierusalema.

verses.en: And he also rehearsed unto them (for it was unto the king and to his servants) all the journeyings of their fathers in the wilderness, and all their sufferings with hunger and thirst, and their travail, and so forth.
verses.sm: Ma sa ia faamatala atu foi ia te i latou (ona o le tupu ma ana auauna sa tautala atu i ai) malaga uma a o latou tamā i le vao, ma o latou mafatiaga uma i le fia aai ma le fia feinu, ma o latou puapuaga, ma isi mea faapena.

verses.en: And he also rehearsed unto them concerning the rebellions of Laman and Lemuel, and the sons of Ishmael, yea, all their rebellions did he  relate unto them; and he expounded unto them all the records and scriptures from the time that Lehi left Jerusalem down to the present time.
verses.sm: Ma sa ia faamatala atu foi ia te i latou e uiga i fouvalega a Lamana ma Lemuelu, ma atalii o Isamaeli, ioe, o a latou fouvalega uma sa ia faamatala atu ia te i latou; ma sa ia faamalamalama atu foi ia te i latou talafaamaumau ma tusitusiga paia uma mai le taimi na tuua ai e Liae Ierusalema seia oo mai lava i le taimi nei.

verses.en: But this is not all; for he expounded unto them the plan of redemption, which was prepared from the foundation of the world; and he also made known unto them concerning the coming of Christ, and all the works of the Lord did he make known unto them.
verses.sm: Ae sa lē na o le pau lea; ona sa ia faamalamalama atu foi ia te i latou le fuafuaga o le togiola, lea na saunia mai le faavaega o le lalolagi; ma sa ia faailoa atu foi ia te i latou e uiga i le afio mai o Keriso, ma sa ia faailoa atu ia te i latou galuega uma a le Alii.

w.en: all the works of the Lord.

verses.en: And it came to pass that after he had said all these things, and expounded them to the king, that the king believed all his words.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina ua uma ona fai atu e ia nei mea uma, ma faamalamalama atu ia mea i le tupu, sa oo ina talitonu le tupu i ana upu uma.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And he began to cry unto the Lord, saying: O Lord, have mercy; according to thy abundant mercy which thou hast had upon the people of Nephi, have upon me, and my people.
verses.sm: Ma sa amata ona ia tagi atu i le Alii, ua faapea atu: Le Alii e, ia e alofa mutimutivale mai; ia i ai i o’u luga, ma luga o lo’u nuu, lou alofa mutimutivale, e tusa ma lou alofa mutimutivale tele ua i ai ia te oe i luga o le nuu o Nifae.

verses.en: And now, when he had said this, he fell unto the earth, as if he were dead.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, ina ua uma ona fai mai e ia nei upu, sa pa’ū ifo o ia i le eleele, e peiseai ua oti o ia.

verses.en: And it came to pass that his servants took him and carried him in unto his wife, and laid him upon a bed; and he lay as if he were dead for the space of two days and two nights; and his wife, and his sons, and his daughters mourned over him, after the manner of the Lamanites, greatly lamenting his loss.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina ave o ia e ana auauna ma avatu o ia i totonu i lana masiofo, ma faataoto o ia i luga o se moega; ma sa taoto o ia mo le va o ao e lua ma po e lua e peiseai ua oti o ia; ma sa fetagisi faanoanoa lana masiofo, ma ona atalii, ma ona afafine i ona luga, e tusa ma le tu a sa Lamanā, ua fetagisi auēuē lava i lona toesea.

w.en: And it came to pass that
